title: Premier League clubs finalise moves as the transfer window narrows
summary: Premier League clubs continued to finalise squad moves through Aug. 26, with Aston Villa announcing Ezri Konsa's move to Arsenal and Aaron Wan-Bissaka's loan to West Ham, alongside Coventry City's additions of Taiwo Awoniyi from Nottingham Forest and Gustavo Hamer from Sheffield United. The summer window closes at 23:00 UK time on Sept. 1, with most clubs still working on at least one late deal before the deadline.
